recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片細胞量豐富，左側可見一顆細胞核分成兩個分離圓核的巨核細胞（separated nuclear lobes），上方有雙核紅血球母細胞，並有核分裂像及大量晚期正染紅血球母細胞，這些發育不良（dysplasia）線索符合 MDS/MPN 伴環狀鐵粒母細胞與血小板增多的骨髓。
features: Megakaryocyte (left) with two widely separated round nuclei and granular cytoplasm, a dysplastic megakaryocytic feature
Binucleated erythroid precursor (upper center) with basophilic cytoplasm, indicating dyserythropoiesis
Erythroid-rich background with numerous orthochromatic and polychromatic normoblasts
Mitotic figure in a large precursor (center right)
Maturing granulocytes including myelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils; no increase in blasts evident in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is cellular with trilineage hematopoiesis and prominent erythroid precursors across all stages of maturation. A megakaryocyte with two widely separated round nuclei and a binucleated erythroid precursor are present, indicating megakaryocytic and erythroid dysplasia; a mitotic figure is also seen. Granulocytic maturation is present and blasts are not increased in this field. Findings are suggestive of a myelodysplastic process and, together with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis, are consistent with myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis; an iron stain is required to quantify ring sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: MDS with ring sideroblasts / SF3B1 mutation
ddx.vs: MDS-RS shares the dyserythropoiesis and ring sideroblasts but lacks the large MPN-like megakaryocytes and platelet count ≥450 x10^9/L.
Megaloblastic change shows nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open chromatin in erythroid precursors and giant metamyelocytes, and corrects with B12/folate.
ET marrow has large hyperlobulated megakaryocytes without erythroid dysplasia or ≥15% ring sideroblasts.

ddx.dx: Copper deficiency / alcohol or drug-induced sideroblastic change
ddx.vs: Toxic/nutritional causes show cytoplasmic vacuolization of precursors and resolve with removal of the cause, without clonal thrombocytosis.
